metadata_method: Kaggle get_model_variation and list_model_variation_version_files read-only APIs; official GitHub source inspection

primary_transformers.checkpoint_hash_policy: Hash all local checkpoint assets at runtime and bind each run identity to the checkpoint manifest before scientific freeze.

secondary_replication.design: Preregistered balanced 30-issue subset of the primary holdout, six matched conditions, one sampling seed (17), maximum 180 attempts; report separately from primary model.

primary_gguf_fallback.activation_rule: Only if the development pilot requires switching the entire primary study before freeze; rebuild all contexts with this GGUF backend and repeat the complete pilot. Never substitute individual failing holdout calls.

standalone_llama_cpp_reference.role: Documented standalone alternative; GraphTrust runner uses the separately pinned Python binding and its vendored submodule.

integrity_policy: The Kaggle metadata API returns file names and sizes, not cryptographic file checksums. Null checksums are unknown, never asserted verified. Check names and sizes on the attached version, compute SHA-256 before inference, and preserve these hashes plus the built wheel hash, build configuration and resolved package environment. A different version, file, quantization or runtime requires a documented lock amendment before model outcomes are inspected.
interpretation: QAT Q4_0 GGUF and Transformers studies have different checkpoint quantization and runtime. Compare corruption robustness within each model/runtime independently; no clean model-size causal comparison.
